notes:
TV Home fixes.

The Home rows are the built-in catalogs again. If you have a metadata add-on installed that also ships a large catalog set, its many extra rows no longer crowd out the Home screen, and those catalogs are not even requested there any more. The add-on itself is untouched: search, browsing, the calendar, metadata and the add-ons page all still use every one of them.

Poster rows keep their left edge. Moving right through a row and back to the start returned the row slightly off, leaving the first poster clipped against the side rail. It now lands exactly where it started, however far you travelled.

The hero banner comes back properly. Scrolling down through Home and then pressing up until you reached Play or More info left the page part-scrolled, with the backdrop, title and description cut off above. Returning to the top now restores the full banner exactly as it looks when Home first opens.
